chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad from Al-Hasan ibn Ali from Aban ibn Uthman from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him)
Regarding His saying, the Mighty and Majestic
The adulterer maries not except an adulteress or a polytheess

He said: They were men and women who were in the time of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) known for adultery, so Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, forbade [marrying] those men and women; and the people today are upon that status, whoever publicized any of that or a legal penalty was established upon him, do not marry him until his repentance is recognized.
ai.seo_question: What is the condition for marrying someone who is known for adultery according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) clarifies that the Quranic prohibition in Surah An-Nur (24:3) specifically targets those notorious for adultery during the Prophet's era, establishing a precedent for public notoriety (shuhrat). This ruling extends to contemporary individuals who are publicly known for such acts or have undergone the legal penalty, prohibiting their marriage until genuine repentance is recognized and verified by the community.
